x.description: array_like Input array. It will be flattened if it is not already 1-D.
constraints: x cannot be None or empty.

equal_nan.description: Equality test for NaN values. If True, then two NaNs are considered equal.
constraints: equal_nan and sorted are either both False or both True.

sorted.description: If True, return the unique elements in sorted order.
constraints: equal_nan and sorted are either both False or both True.

output.description: ------- ndarray The unique elements of an input array.

constraints: equal_nan and sorted are either both False or both True.
